subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Reconhecer a função de textos utilizados para apresentar informações coletadas em atividades de pesquisa (enquetes, pequenas entrevistas, registros de experimentações).

components.description_pt: Reconhecer a função comunicativa de textos que apresentam achados de pesquisa
components.description_en: Recognize the communicative function of texts that present research findings
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish reasoned judgments based on research findings from unsupported opinion

components.description_pt: Identificar gêneros como pesquisas, breves entrevistas e registros de experimentos como veículos de informação
components.description_en: Identify genres such as surveys, brief interviews, and experiment logs as vehicles for presenting research information
components.cc_component_description: Identify the features and limitations of print, digital, video, and multimedia formats for presenting information

cc_matches.description: Distinguish among facts, reasoned judgment based on research findings, and speculation in a text.
Evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of using different mediums (e.g., print or digital text, video, multimedia) to present a particular topic or idea.
